name: ECB decision
consensus_source: Reuters poll of 73 economists, 2026-10-05 to 10-08 (70 of 73 expected a hold at 2.50%)
read: ECB held the deposit rate at 2.50% (0bp), in line with the Reuters poll hold call. 64 of 73 economists in that poll expect a 25bp hike in December; guidance wording unconfirmed. Hold with hike bias is EUR-supportive.

fields.guidance_tone: unconfirmed (hold; statement text not yet published on ECB pages)
